method: 150 Nifty-500 names scored as of 7 past dates (Jul 2024 to Jul 2026) with statements cut at each date and market cap rescaled to the as-of price; forward return over the next 126 sessions minus the sample mean on that date. News and insider data were unavailable historically, so the sentiment analyst is untested.

buy.note: a Buy from this engine was followed by about +16% vs peers over six months, but that rests on only 12 different stocks (mostly PSU banks and metals in one cycle): encouraging, not proven

hold.note: a Hold has tracked its peers (53 past cases)

sell.note: a Sell has not predicted underperformance (-0.6% vs peers over six months, 818 past cases) because several analysts are bearish on nearly every stock; read it as 'no Buy case', not as a signal to sell

reweighting: Tested with leave-one-date-out and rejected: ranking skill was unchanged (rank IC 0.109 vs 0.111) and the extra Buy calls it produced beat peers by only 3% with a 32% hit rate, so votes are not reweighted.
caveats: Cases repeat the same stocks across dates; the Buy result is 34 cases but 12 stocks.
All seven dates fall in up-regimes by the 200-day rule; nothing here speaks to bear markets.
Half of the Buy stocks were already in the owner's book when the sample was drawn.
